role: Sanity bounds for numbers arriving from the Watch: RR intervals kept only when finite and within (300, 2500) ms, heart rates only within 25...250 bpm.
types: WatchPayloadBounds: enum (namespace) — validation of Watch-sent RR/HR

units.does: Filters RR values to those whose rounded value is finite and strictly between HRVConstants.RRValidity.watchSynthesisMinExclusive (300) and watchSynthesisMaxExclusive (2500); returns the original (unrounded) values.
Returns bpm when non-nil and within 25...250, else nil.
